name: course-messenger
title: Course Messenger
description: A workspace for course channels, direct messages and threads.
usage: <CourseMessenger workspace="Studio" channels={[{ id: "design", name: "design", kind: "channel", topic: "Review" }]} initialMessages={{ design: [] }} />
useCases: In a course workspace, a student discusses an assignment in the cohort channel and opens a thread for a specific question.
In a team workspace, a colleague moves between direct and shared conversations. The app synchronizes messages and reactions with its server.

onSend.type: ((channelId: string, text: string, parentId?: string) => void | Promise<void>) | undefined

onToggleReaction.type: ((channelId: string, postId: string, emoji: string) => void) | undefined

task: Build a messaging workspace with channels, direct messages, reactions and threads.
behavior: Use initialMessages for local state. For server-backed conversations pass messages keyed by channel ID, persist replies with onSend and update reactions through onToggleReaction. The third onSend argument identifies the parent message in a thread.
